title: A Frugal AI Framework for India: Responsible and Right-sized AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.27189v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: India's AI debate often swings between two insufficient options: replicating the compute-intensive, capital-heavy foundation-model programmes of the United States or China, or remaining a downstream adopter of foreign AI with localised interfaces and safeguards. Neither serves a country that must deliver AI to a very large, diverse population across uneven infrastructure and within constrained budgets. This white paper from the Centre for Responsible AI (CeRAI), IIT Madras, proposes a third path: Responsible Frugal AI, which applies principle-based frugal engineering alongside Responsible AI. Responsible Frugal AI is right-sized AI: it fixes the functional requirement first, asks whether AI is needed at all, and then chooses the smallest sufficient model, meeting the requirement with minimal resources while keeping a verified margin, robustness and responsible governance. translated_title: 面向印度的节俭人工智能框架：负责任且规模适度的AI
translated_abstract: 印度关于人工智能的争论常常在两个并不充分的选择之间摇摆：要么复制美国或中国那种计算密集、资本密集的基础模型计划，要么停留在作为外国人工智能的下游采用者，仅提供本地化的界面与安全保障。这两者都无法满足一个需要在基础设施不均衡、预算有限的条件下，向极其庞大且多样化的人口提供人工智能服务的国家。这份来自印度理工学院马德拉斯分校负责任人工智能中心（CeRAI）的白皮书提出了第三条路径：负责任节俭AI（Responsible Frugal AI），它将基于原则的节俭工程与负责任AI相结合。负责任节俭AI是“规模适度”的AI：它首先明确功能需求，追问是否真的需要AI，然后选择最小的充分模型，以最少的资源满足需求，同时保持经过验证的余量、鲁棒性和负责任的治理。该框架在四个维度上应用节俭原则（数据、计算……（摘要原文在此处截断））。
tldr: 本文提出“负责任节俭AI”框架，主张印度既不应照搬中美重资本的基础模型路线，也不应仅作外国AI的下游采用者，而应先明确功能需求并判断是否需要AI，再选择以最少资源满足需求的最小充分“规模适度”模型，同时保持鲁棒性与负责任治理。
en_tdlr: This white paper proposes Responsible Frugal AI, a "right-sized AI" framework offering India a third path—beyond replicating US/China capital-heavy foundation-model programs or merely adopting foreign AI—by first fixing functional requirements, questioning whether AI is needed at all, and then selecting the smallest sufficient model with minimal resources while preserving verified margin, robustness, and responsible governance.
